loss: target MIT MAE + mean of three target visible ORT MAEs; weights 1:1
stop: paired stop when BOTH branches stale >=8; checkpoints individually selected on D05 equal target-condition standardized clipped MAE
clip: all methods lower bounded at 0; save raw predictions
train_sampling: one query per training window per epoch; uniform targets and conditions; same schedules M/H
phase: normal=outside documented intervals; active=[start,end); recovery=[end,end_exclusion); active wins overlap; recovery is exclusion-period proxy, not certified physical recovery
change: train q90 absolute adjacent delta, high iff delta>threshold; threshold zero gives positive-change stratum; undefined delta separately
examples: D06 then D07, first scoreable window, each target, gap120, mask101, model seed17
fit_selection: no test scores until all six checkpoints frozen
